1) the DDT is an effective, differentiable, modular component of deep learning models that can be used to improve interpretability of a model, and 2) the SVAE+DDT is a competitive classifier+VAE that is easy to implement.

we introduce a differentiable decision tree that can be combined with deep neural network classifiers, and we show how a supervised VAE can be used for generative modeling with a Gaussian mixture latent space and improved log-likelihood.

the proposed C+VAE is a competitive classifier that is both interpretable and has a good generative model.
the DDT can be used to compress high-dimensional input data into a low-dimensional space, which can be used to train a single decision tree classifier that can be used to classify the input data.
we propose the DDT as a simple and modular way to incorporate interpretable, single decision trees into any deep network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new framework to combine the advantages of deep learning, VAEs, and interpretable decision trees.
we propose a new method to combine the strengths of decision trees and VAEs, and that we show the importance of labeled data in the SVAE.
we introduce two novel components to deep neural networks that are simple to implement, easy to train, and improve both classification error and model interpretability.

we can learn interpretable classifiers that are competitive with state-of-the-art models in both performance and interpretability.
a simple decision tree can be a useful component for a deep network, even if it is not the final layer.
